### Service

- `WEB_AUTH_ORIGIN`: Auth's origin, such as `https://auth.piquel.fr`. piquel.fr links its pages and redirects every other path there. Required.
- `WEB_LISTENER`: The address piquel-web listens on, behind piqueld's gateway. Default: `127.0.0.1:8080`.
